about: Grape varieties authorised in a Swiss canton's AOC by its own wine law, read where no register lists varieties: the list as the law gives it, each name mapped by hand to the library's grape (a name that could be several — «muscat», «auxerrois», «arvine» — is left out; «riesling-sylvaner» is Müller-Thurgau). Official texts, free to reuse (Swiss Copyright Act, art. 5). scripts/kb/build-appellations.ts checks each quote against the law's text as cached in .kb-cache/ch-law/.
